meta.title: Every Season — Set 1
meta.subject: English Reading
meta.description: Comprehension quiz for 'Every Season' — understanding key seasonal events.

questions.question: What color does the grass grow in spring?
questions.explanation: According to the story, grass grows green in spring.

questions.question: Speckled eggs fill woven nests in spring.
questions.explanation: Yes, spring is the season when speckled eggs fill woven nests as birds lay eggs.

questions.question: What brings icicles and snowflakes in winter?
questions.explanation: The cold temperature of winter brings icicles and swirling snowflakes.

questions.question: In summer, you can wear a straw hat or go barefoot in the grass.
questions.explanation: True! The sun is strong and hot in summer, so you can wear a straw hat or walk without shoes.

questions.question: What happens to the leaves in autumn?
questions.explanation: In autumn, leaves turn color (orange, red, yellow) and fall from the trees.

questions.question: In spring, crocuses pop and _______ open.
questions.hint: A type of yellow spring flower mentioned in the text.
questions.explanation: The text states: 'Crocuses pop. Daffodils open, then lilacs spread their sweet smell.'

questions.question: What do horses grow in winter to keep warm?
questions.explanation: The story says: 'Horses grow thick coats to keep warm.'

questions.question: Sort these animals based on the season they appear in the story:
questions.explanation: Ducklings, lambs, and rabbits are mentioned in the spring section, while chickadees search for seeds in winter.

questions.question: Chipmunks store acorns in a secret spot during summer.
questions.explanation: False. Chipmunks store acorns during autumn, getting ready for the coming winter.

questions.question: Arrange the words to show what we wear in winter:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'We wear mittens in winter.' In winter, we also wear hats and scarves.

questions.question: What do geese do in autumn?
questions.explanation: The text says: 'Geese honk and head south' in autumn.

questions.question: Summer is the time to splash and _______.
questions.hint: An action you do in the water.
questions.explanation: The text says: 'Summer is the time to splash and swim.'

questions.question: Arrange the words to describe the geese in autumn:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'Geese honk and head south.' Geese fly south to find warmer weather.

questions.question: In winter, snow blankets branches and buds, but animals leave no tracks.
questions.explanation: False. The text says: 'Animals leave their tracks' in the snow.

questions.question: Why is winter the time to 'coast and slide'?
options: Because the ground is hot and dry.
Because snow and ice make the hills slippery.
Because leaves are piled up on the ground.
questions.explanation: Winter brings icicles, snowflakes, and snow blankets, making it the perfect time to slide and coast on ice and snow.
